name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: Calendar double-tap robustness fix: replace the selected-date full-cell 0.5 s redraw loop with a lightweight blinking selection frame, wrap selection/touch handling so an unexpected drawing error cannot disable later taps, and give a short buzz when a date is selected. Keep V0.58 always-ready Orbit touch behavior and 400 ms tap timing.
